text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On this day— 
I was once again searching for old texts 
with Azuma-san.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Well then... We shall accept 
these volumes with profound gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman
text_block_list.text:
Please, take them! It's been so long since 
I had the chance to reminisce, so I'm 
truly glad.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman
text_block_list.text:
You really are so knowledgeable, Lady 
Azuma... 
You understand horsegirls through and 
through.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... 
Most of it is merely lore gleaned from my 
library.

text_block_list.name: Granddaughter Horsegirl
text_block_list.text: ...U-Um! Lady Azuma...!

text_block_list.name: Granddaughter Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Someone as incredible as you must know a 
whole lot 
about horsegirl bodies too, right?! 
...There's something I really need advice 
on!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After thanking the owner of the texts and 
stepping outside, 
Azuma-san paused, watching the young 
horsegirl run.

text_block_list.name: Granddaughter Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*... 
It's been like this the whole time 
lately... 
My legs just won't move the way I want 
them to.

text_block_list.name: Granddaughter Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
They won't stretch out properly, I 
guess... 
Even when I run like I used to, it feels 
like the brakes are on. 
It doesn't hurt or anything, though...

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
... 
May I examine your legs up close?

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
This tension... 
It is the sign of a turning point 
that comes to horsegirls in the prime of 
growth.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
When the body undergoes a rapid spurt, 
the muscles and tendons must adapt in 
kind. 
Stiffness during such times is only 
natural.

text_block_list.name: Granddaughter Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
I did shoot up in height a lot recently, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Hence, it stands to reason 
that you cannot run as you wish for now...

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
There is no cause for haste. 
Keep yourself warm, loosen the muscles 
well, 
and allow your body to adapt bit by bit.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Once you pass through this transitional 
threshold... 
you will attain an even finer stride 
alongside your renewed body.

text_block_list.name: Granddaughter Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much, Lady Azuma...! 
I'm so glad I asked you...!

text_block_list.name: Granddaughter Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
T-Then...! 
Can I ask you just one more thing?!

text_block_list.name: Granddaughter Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
I'm running in a selection race soon! 
Could you give me some strategic advice?!

text_block_list.name: Granddaughter Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
With all your knowledge, Lady Azuma, 
you must know about races from all kinds 
of eras, right? 
Like how to run according to the current 
trends—

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
—... 
If it be universal principles, I can speak 
of them. 
...Yet I suspect that is not what you 
seek.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Therefore... forgive me. 
I do not possess the answer 
that you are looking for at present.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
For racing currents—the "trends"— 
are ever shifting in the blink of an eye.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
In the distant past—before race formats 
and running styles 
diverged into branches— 
the utmost value was placed upon 
conquering great distance.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
In those days, the strong were those who 
could endure 
the arduous journey and still retain 
strength to spare.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
With the passage of time, shorter sprints 
were born, 
and raw speed came to be revered in turn—

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Races multiplied, systems transformed, 
and each found a stage best suited to 
their gifts.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Those who seize the front, those who press 
ahead in the vanguard, 
those who bide their time to strike, and 
those who surge from the rear.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
And yet... 
which of these is held in highest regard 
today?

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
While pursuing boundless lore and tracing 
history... 
my perception of time drifted apart 
from that of the world before I even 
realized.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Even that which feels so recent to me 
has long since slipped into antiquity...

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
"Trends" vanish in the briefest flicker of 
a moment, 
far beyond my ability to pursue.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Compared to the vast expanse of history, 
the present moment could easily be viewed 
as a mere flash. 
Her perception of time operates on a 
completely different scale.
choice_data_list:
In that case, how about I offer some 
advice?

In that case, how about I offer some 
advice?

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Ah... 
You are a Trainer of Tracen Academy. 
Every path has its own master, as they 
say.

text_block_list.name: Granddaughter Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Wait, really?! 
Please, I'd love your help...!
choice_data_list:
Alright, show me how you run one more 
time.

text_block_list.name: Granddaughter Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*... Thank you so much! 
I'll work through these body changes 
and make sure I win that race...!

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to offer my gratitude as well. 
Thanks to your guidance, 
she has found a new path forward.
choice_data_list:
If there's ever anything I can do, I'm 
always happy to help.

If there's ever anything I can do, I'm 
always happy to help.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Hoho. You possess a kind and gentle 
heart... 
I am truly grateful 
to have formed this bond with you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Being able to assist Azuma-san like this 
brought me genuine joy. 
I decided I'd write about that happiness 
in my diary later.
